title: Cross-Agent Operating Kit — Personal
summary:
More agents don’t automatically create more control.

When ownership, permissions, human gates, budgets, and stop rules drift, coordination becomes the bottleneck.

Cross-Agent Operating Kit gives a multi-AI stack one shared operating layer:
• Master policy
• Agent adapters
• Conflict checks
• Human Gate Matrix
• Budget + quota guards
• Migration score

Fix the operating layer before adding another agent.
